Module np.cincuentazo
Package np.cincuentazo.controller

Class GameController

java.lang.Object
np.cincuentazo.controller.GameController
public class GameController extends Object
Main FXML controller for the Cincuentazo game.

Responsibilities:

  • Reacts to user-input events declared in game-view.fxml.
  • Delegates turn management to TurnController.
  • Keeps every JavaFX node in sync with the GameState after each action.
  • Manages the TurnTimerThread that gives the human player a time limit.

Threading contract: every method in this class runs on the JavaFX Application Thread. Callbacks from MachinePlayerThread and TurnTimerThread use Platform.runLater() before calling into this controller.

Keyboard shortcuts: once the game scene is active, the player can use keys 1â€“4 to play a card by position and SPACE/ENTER to draw from the deck. Shortcuts are dispatched through a keyboardActions lookup table (an EnumMap) rather than a long switch, registered once via an Scene event filter attached through a sceneProperty() listener â€” this keeps keyboard wiring independent from startNewGame() and safe against being attached before the scene exists.

    • startHumanTurnTimer

      public void startHumanTurnTimer()
      Starts a 30-second countdown timer for the human player's turn. Each tick updates lblActionMsg with the remaining seconds. If the timer expires, the human player is automatically eliminated.

      Called by TurnController when it confirms the human has at least one valid card to play. A new timer replaces any previously running one.
